query:
SELECT a.served_type AS "served_type!"
           FROM artifacts a
           JOIN blobs b ON b.project_id = a.project_id AND b.sha256 = a.sha256
          WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.class = $2 AND a.sha256 = decode($3, 'hex')
            AND a.state = 'available' AND b.state = 'present'
          LIMIT 1
